description_en: Queries the status of a task for batch registering LoRaWAN devices
description_zh: 调用该接口查询批量注册LoRaWAN设备任务的状态
name: GetLoraNodesTask

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task for registering LoRaWAN devices. This is the TaskId returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109299.html to create the task
parameters.help_zh: 注册LoRaWAN设备任务的ID，即调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109299.html创建任务后，返回的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of devices that were successfully registered

TaskId.description_en: The task ID returned if the call was successful
TaskId.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的任务ID

TaskState.description_en:
The execution status of the task.

RUNNING: The task is being executed.

FINISH: The task is complete
TaskState.description_zh:
任务执行状态。

RUNNING：任务正在执行中。

FINISH：任务已执行完毕

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of devices to be registered in the task
TotalCount.description_zh: 任务中待注册设备的总数
